description: Terminate an app by its iOS bundle ID or Android package ID on the active exact runtime. On a real iOS device, terminating the app under test keeps WebDriverAgent available for subsequent commands; the screen may show WDA's runner until app_activate or ceraph_start relaunches the app. iOS Simulator and Android runs do not need this iOS auto-lock safeguard.

projectDir.description: React Native/Expo project directory. Omit when the coding client's workspace identifies one app; supply it to disambiguate projects.

name: app_terminate
